Culture.name: {=culture_empire}Equestria
Culture.text: {=culture_empire_text}The ponies of Equestria: earth ponies, pegasi and unicorns under the alicorn princesses.

Culture.name: {=culture_vlandia}Gryphons
Culture.text: {=culture_vlandia_text}The gryphons of Griffonstone: proud and tight-fisted, but true to their word.

Culture.name: {=culture_battania}Hippogriffs
Culture.text: {=culture_battania_text}The hippogriffs of Mount Aris and the seaponies of Seaquestria.

Culture.name: {=culture_nord}Oleni
Culture.text: {=culture_nord_text}The deer of the northern woods: silent trackers and stubborn archers.

Culture.name: {=culture_sturgia}Dragons
Culture.text: {=culture_sturgia_text}The dragons of the volcanic lands: strength, hoards, and the Gauntlet of Fire for the Bloodstone Scepter.

Culture.name: {=culture_khuzait}Yaks
Culture.text: {=culture_khuzait_text}The yaks of Yakyakistan: loud, honest and very fond of smashing things.

Culture.name: {=culture_aserai}Changelings
Culture.text: {=culture_aserai_text}The changelings of the hives: shapeshifters who feed on the love of others.
